workload.scope: Real CPU work with complete observable output; allocation loops and checksum-only synthetic pointer chains do not qualify as product work.
candidate_requires: actual source function and caller/lifetime contract
fixed ordinary-optimized A1 rather than an intentionally weak allocator baseline
input hash, output oracle, completed-work count and success/fallback semantics
identical algorithm, tier/quality, initialization, alignment and output lifetime
CPU-owned backing with a practical fallible Memory integration point

A1.definition: The conventional optimized native System path for this exact workload.
requirements: Reuse normal scratch or one dense System backing when already justified by the same lifetime contract.
Do not allocate every frame in A1 while retaining the same workspace across frames only in A3.
Preserve necessary initialization, input/output separation, warm work and semantic revalidation.
Freeze the baseline source before formal sampling; retain every pilot and baseline revision.

A2.definition: Memory System provider with identical backing, ownership, zeroing, copies, layout, lifetime and completed work as A1.
A2.warning: Existing image --system is a Memory System mode, not by itself a conventional A1. If storage semantics differ, label the difference migration-plus-integration cost.

A3.definition: A1 work through the installed Memory arena/region and explicit lifetime contract, including its integration and final cleanup costs.
requirements: Use the same task/batch boundary and output lifetime as A1.
Include domain/setup, allocation, required initialization and copies, leases, actual CPU algorithm, reset/trim when applicable, begin_close/collect/drain/destroy in total task time.
Acquire asynchronous leases before admission; never force-free on timeout.
Record retained/padding/reservation and old-new coexistence peaks rather than only live payload.

freeze_prerequisites.device_occupancy: Confirmed free of other session work, then exclusive ownership recorded before any workload launch.
required_fields: exact workload and real inputs/output oracle
A1/A3 code, compiler/options, installed Memory artifact and executable SHA256
physical device OS/kernel/build, ABI, page size and available CPU affinity set
same completion unit and initialization/lifetime contract
pilot receipt and independent formal sample-count decision
seeded complete ABBA/BAAB order, stopping rule and resource/time limits
available thermal/background/frequency/migration observations and their exact limitations
numeric eligibility thresholds decided without looking at formal outcomes
freeze_prerequisites.rule: Create and hash a resolved protocol after pilot and before formal data; this draft is not permission to label exploratory data confirmatory.

measurement.primary_metric: CLOCK_MONOTONIC elapsed nanoseconds per identical successfully completed task/session, including the full selected lifetime contract.
measurement.process_start_and_file_IO: Choose before freeze. Prefer fixed input loaded before each timed native task, plus a separately reported load-and-task end-to-end metric; both variants use identical boundaries.
measurement.phase_rule: Nested phase timers are diagnostic only and not summed into elapsed twice.
measurement.session_state: New independent task owner/domain per session; no A3-only retained state carried between statistical units.
measurement.calibration: Use pilot only to choose one fixed completed-work count targeting approximately 250 ms per session; do not adapt iterations separately by variant.
measurement.limit_rule: The fixed work and bounded actual input may need a smaller or different budget; freeze that value. Reaching a time/budget cap stops with all samples retained and an incomplete/inconclusive result.

sampling.unit: One predeclared four-session time block. Inner frames/records/loop iterations are correlated operations, not independent samples.
sampling.order_assignment: Balanced count of ABBA and BAAB blocks, deterministically shuffled by a seed committed before collection. Each block uses the same input sequence and completed work for both variants.

sample_size_method.block_log_ratio: d_b = mean(log(T_A3)) - mean(log(T_A1)) for the two sessions of each variant in block b.
sample_size_method.provisional_calculation: N0 = ceil((1.96 * pilot_sd(d_b) / 0.01)^2); round max(32,N0) up to a multiple of 8, cap at 96.
sample_size_method.interpretation: A planning approximation from a small pilot, not a guaranteed confidence width or a power proof. Record pilot_sd, chosen N and cap activation before formal sampling.
sample_size_method.insufficient_precision: If planning requires more than the cap or the final interval is too wide, report INCONCLUSIVE; do not alter N after inspecting gains.

sampling.formal_stop: Exactly the frozen eligible block count, or the predeclared total-time/resource/failure cap. No early stop for significance or favorable result.

analysis.primary_estimator: g = 1 - exp(mean(d_b)) over complete eligible blocks; this is the geometric paired time ratio, not arithmetic elapsed reduction of an arbitrary summed run.
analysis.interval: Two-sided 95% percentile bootstrap over whole block d_b values, 20000 resamples with a frozen seed. Transform log-ratio endpoints through 1-exp(d) in reverse order.
analysis.dependence_limit: Time blocks reduce within-block correlation; they are not automatically independent. Report ordered d_b and exploratory lag-1 correlation. If clear time trends/persistent serial dependence remain, label the interval exploratory and qualify with longer independently scheduled sessions before adoption.
analysis.sensitivity: Also report the paired arithmetic ratio and all-attempt resource/failure summary, clearly secondary. Do not choose the estimator with the best gain.
analysis.tail_metrics: Do not report p95/p99 from 32-96 blocks as precise product tail estimates.
analysis.workload_multiplicity: Choose one primary workload before formal collection; any additional sizes, modes or workloads are separately labeled secondary/exploratory.

environment_and_failures.device_state_changes: No governor/thermal/sysfs/THP/MTE/global process-policy changes. CPU affinity may be applied only to this benchmark process if legal and already supported.
environment_and_failures.affinity: Prefer one confirmed allowed CPU for every timed session, fixed before pilot/formal. Failure to enforce intended affinity is explicit; start/end CPU equality alone is not a migration counter.
environment_and_failures.threshold_rule: Resolve numeric thresholds from actual available, documented observations before freeze; never invent a CPU temperature from a battery sensor. Missing capabilities stay UNAVAILABLE and narrow qualification.
environment_and_failures.prelaunch_ineligible: Record the gate failure and cooldown/skip before launching. Do not silently discard it.
environment_and_failures.postlaunch_violations: Retain complete raw results and flag the block. Report all-attempt and prespecified eligible-subset results; never drop only a slow variant or use post hoc limits.
environment_and_failures.semantic_failure: Record as functional failure, not a fast timing. Any unexplained A3 failure, output mismatch, timeout or extra fallback prevents adoption.
environment_and_failures.diagnostic_separation: Allocation ledgers, RSS/PSS polling, tracing and detailed counters run separately from low-disturbance timing. Record matching workload and same completion unit for both rounds.
metrics: CPU affinity and available migration evidence

decision_gates.time_gain_route: Primary point gain >= 3% and paired 95% gain interval lower bound > 0, with zero correctness/lifecycle failures and all selected regression gates satisfied. The 3% is a predeclared engineering criterion, never a value to prove or backfill.
decision_gates.memory_gain_route: Unique owned-backing peak reduction >= 10% and the upper 95% time-ratio bound <= 1.02, with identical work and zero safety failures; RSS savings require separate real observation.
decision_gates.interpretation: Do not declare a pass when noise cannot establish the applicable bounds; a point estimate alone is insufficient.
BIL_adoption_additional: The selected CPU function is actually used by BIL and has matching observed input/lifetime/hot-path behavior.
Installed native integration preserves origin-owner, success/fallback/quality and deadline behavior.
Current A1 scratch/P1-07 and packed gains are not counted again.
Measure integration/bridge costs and complete BIL-specific functional/device regressions before default enablement.
decision_gates.fallback: No stable net benefit or insufficient evidence => keep System/current BIL path; record NO_GAIN or INCONCLUSIVE with all evidence, without weakening baseline or reducing work.

separate_blockers.scope_rule: A bounded arm64 4KB timing result does not qualify missing 16KB/MTE/energy, every device, or BIL end-to-end performance.
